First confirm what you want to research, then read the admissions brochure of the applying school and department for the current academic year. Eligibility, document review, fee payment, and interviews each have specific requirements; simply completing the form is not enough.

First check the department's current selection announcements, then confirm portfolio, language proficiency, subsidies, and travel documents. Past news reports on internships in Japan do not mean applications are currently open.

Can my part-time work hours count toward the internship requirement?
Can I still submit a late credit-transfer application for Semester 115-1?
Can graduating seniors apply for the university's 116 Master's early admissions before receiving their diploma?
